title: Cucumber Fractured Dream
description: A surreal cracked painting features a large central human eye surrounded by floating green cucumbers, glowing pink neon shapes, and translucent female figures. The composition blends organic forms with vine leaves against a dark purple and black fractured background.
prompt: Surreal dark painting of a large detailed human eye at the center, cracked and fragmented like broken glass, surrounded by oversized green cucumbers and curling vines. Translucent glowing female figures float in the negative space, bright pink neon glowing shapes and circles, dark purple and black background with dramatic lighting, organic and chaotic composition.
